item.title: Ronan Boyce signs for St Pat’s
item.description: St Pat’s have snapped up Ramelton’s Ronan Boyce from Derry City, as they plan for the 2026 Premier Division season. The right-back made 175 appearances for the Candystripes, having joined in 2019. He’s the second signing made by the Saints in the off-season, with ex-Sligo Rovers forward Max Mata also heading to Richmond Park.
